steps: `tests/lib.sh` defines `wait_for <max seconds> <command…>`: the command runs every 0.1 s until it exits 0 (return 0) or the time is up (return 1 after printing `wait_for: <command> still failing after <max> s`); `in_has`, `settle` and `ran` are rewritten on it and `grep -c 'seq 20\|seq 150' tests/lib.sh` prints 0

features.description: The claude stub prints a session id, answers --resume as the real CLI does and can skip or redo an entry; metrics.mjs reads a session id and computes a resume's difference row.

The stub accepts `--resume <id>`, appending its argv to `$STUB_DIR/resume.log`: an id of no session it ran prints the stderr line and the `error_during_execution` result line of `tests/fixtures/claude-resume/unknown-id.out` and exits 1; a known id prints a transcript whose init line carries the same `session_id` and whose `result` line's `total_cost_usd` is cumulative (the earlier run's plus this one's), as `resumed.jsonl` shows

`STUB_NO_ENTRY=<id>`: that feature's first coding session writes no `entry.json`; `STUB_RESUME_ENTRY=good|bad`: a resumed session writes a valid entry with one `dead_ends` item (good) or `{not json` (bad); `STUB_RESUME_ENTRY=good-edits` also writes `resumed.txt` in the worktree; the stub's header comment documents all three, and a check runs the stub directly with `STUB_NO_ENTRY=A` and finds no entry.json

`lib/metrics.mjs session-id <transcript>` prints the init line's `session_id`; a pure, exported function builds an `entry-resume` row from a session transcript and its resume transcript whose `cost_usd` and token fields are the resume's cumulative figures minus the session's; checks in `tests/checks/05-metrics-pure-tokens-cache.sh` use `tests/fixtures/claude-resume/first.jsonl` and `resumed.jsonl`: the difference equals the two result lines' `total_cost_usd` difference as jq computes it, and `resumed-again-under-cap.jsonl` against `resumed.jsonl` gives a difference that is positive
Every new check name is one line in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; `bash -n tests/stub-claude.sh` and `node --check lib/metrics.mjs` pass

features.description: A session whose entry would be minimal is resumed once to write it; the resume's cost is its own metrics row and never a session in MAX_SESSIONS.

`lib/record.sh`: after an ingest that would be minimal for a coding, verify or init session that `MET limit` did not refuse, the driver runs `$CLAUDE -p <the rendered prompt> --resume <the init line's session_id>` once with the session's model, settings and MCP flags, `--max-turns $ENTRY_RESUME_TURNS`, under `timeout $ENTRY_RESUME_TIMEOUT`, `--max-budget-usd` = the session's `total_cost_usd` + `ENTRY_RESUME_BUDGET_USD`, in a new scope unit `s<n>`, transcript at `<nn>-<id>.resume.jsonl` beside the session's; then `restrict` reverts anything but the run record and the ingest runs again

`STUB_NO_ENTRY=A STUB_RESUME_ENTRY=bad` → A's entry is minimal and `harness-log.md` has `A: entry.json still invalid` and `after one resume; recorded a minimal entry` on one line; a session refused by a usage limit (the existing limit scenario of `tests/checks/18-run-9c-refused-sessions.sh` or `16-run-6-limit-cuts.sh`) leaves `$STUB_DIR/resume.log` absent; `STUB_RESUME_ENTRY=good-edits` → `resumed.txt` is in no commit of the lane branch (`git log --all -- resumed.txt` prints nothing) and the entry is still written
Every new check name is one line in `tests/fixtures/check-names.txt`; `bash -n lib/record.sh lib/config.sh` passes
